semantically_equivalent_models.justification: Shallownet and Self-Normalizing Networks cannot be considered semantically Equivalent at this time.

parent_models.justification: Semantically, self-normalizing networks are designed to be fully-connected neural networks with specific activation functions like Selu, cheering layers by stabilizing the variance. Hence, Fully-Connected Neural Networks are parent models.

They can be seen also from the domain level where self-normalizing networks are a specific type of fully convolutional neural network providing a equal part attack technique to the FC thus making them a parent model.

closest_parent_model.justification: fully-connected neural networks fit well as the closest parent because self-normalizing networks addon to the existing architectures for them by using SELU-like activations.

child_models.justification: Given Self-normalizing networks share a mathematical similarity to normalizing flows variants where they use the activation stabilization technique making them a child model.

closest_child_model.justification: The normalization technique which is pivotal in the self-normalizing aids visualization by helping with the same kind of mathematical similarity in normalizing flows variate showing a clear closest relevance.

sibling_models.justification: Both residual networks like self-normalizing networks try to solve issues persistent with deep neural networks through various means, for instance, ensuring stable weight distributions making residual networks siblings.

closest_sibling_model.justification: Residual networks are a closely associated sibling to self-normalizing networks considering they adopt innovative techniques to combat widespread DNN issues like vanishing/exploding gradients.

unrelated_models.justification: Matching networks are used for one-shot learning scenarios which are far from self-normalizing network's variations.
Target networks often seen in reinforcement learning differ from the philosophy of self-normalizing networks.
Graph networks typically don't share the conceptual ground or targets with self-normalizing networks.
Focusing mainly on permutation Invariance has little to do with the ambitions of self-normalizing networks.
Being oriented towards segmentation task, cnn U-Net networks address distinctive set of concerns from self-normalizing networks.
Graph Networks predominantly managing relational data don't hold much in common.
Temporal graph networks manage an array of temporal data that does not hash out close to self-normalizing networks.
Aiming to capture traditional CNN behaviours they fall outside the contextual boundaries of self-normalizing networks.
They are directed purposing probabilistic encodings standing aside the deployment roles of self-normalizing networks.
Presenting binary decision making architectures distinct to the working realm of self-normalizing networks.
Manifest task-based architecture distinct in operations.
Despite group forming activity their context does not align with self-normalizing networks.
Exclusively engaging with graph data processing places it outside the fold delineating self-normalizing networks.
Without holding equivalence not aligning with ideological or functional overlap applicable to self-normalizing functions.
